Container.Name: ChannelFlow-Next
Container.Overview: ErsatzTV next — the transcoding/streaming engine ChannelFlow drives. ChannelFlow writes lineup.json, per-channel channel.json, and dynamic playout windows into the shared config folder and pushes what-to-play over HTTP. Serve movies/TV/Music channels through here instead of ChannelFlow's own ffmpeg for reliable, hardware-accelerated HLS.
Container.Requires: Start it AFTER ChannelFlow has saved its General → ErsatzTV next settings once, so the config folder exists. Mount /media at the same path ChannelFlow mounts it so file paths in playouts match. Restart this container after enabling next, adding/renumbering channels, or changing normalization.

Config.Name: HTTP
Config.Description: ErsatzTV next HTTP server (HLS, channels.m3u, xmltv.xml). ChannelFlow proxies these; no need to expose publicly.

Config.Name: Shared config
Config.Description: ChannelFlow writes lineup.json, channels/ and playouts here. Must be exactly the appdata/channelflow/next folder ChannelFlow creates (General → Enabling next).

Config.Name: Media
Config.Description: Same library share Jellyfin and ChannelFlow use, mounted at the same /media path so playout file paths resolve.

Config.Name: Intel GPU
Config.Description: Pass /dev/dri for Intel VAAPI (h264_vaapi). Normalization/accel comes from the channel config ChannelFlow writes.

Config.Name: TZ
Config.Description: IANA time zone. Match ChannelFlow General → schedule time zone so playout windows line up.
